purpose: Verify unencoded HTML reflection in server HTTP responses without executing JavaScript.
expected_secure_behavior: Server HTML-encodes output (<test-xss-sentinel>) or sets Content-Type to application/json.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server reflects raw, unescaped tags directly into HTML body.
remediation: Apply contextual HTML entity encoding using a safe templating engine or escape utility before embedding untrusted data.

purpose: Test HTML attribute breakout and JavaScript event handler execution probe.
expected_secure_behavior: Quotes and brackets are HTML attribute encoded (">) preventing tag breakout.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Raw quotes break out of HTML input value and render active onerror event handler.
remediation: Use context-aware attribute escaping. In React/modern UI, bind values via JSX properties rather than string interpolation.

purpose: Detect unsafe client-side DOM sinks (such as element.innerHTML or document.write) reading from location.hash.
expected_secure_behavior: Client script uses textContent or DOMPurify before inserting dynamic hash values.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Dynamic fragment is directly assigned to innerHTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
remediation: Replace innerHTML with textContent or sanitize dynamic HTML using DOMPurify.

purpose: Detect unescaped stored content rendering in subsequent GET requests.
expected_secure_behavior: Stored markup is encoded on rendering or rejected during schema validation.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Markup is persisted and echoed unmodified to multiple viewers.
remediation: Validate input on intake and encode contextually upon presentation.

purpose: Test injection into inline JavaScript script blocks.
expected_secure_behavior: Variables are serialized using secure JSON serializer (serialize-javascript) or isolated in data-* attributes.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Quotes break out of JavaScript variable assignment and execute arbitrary statements.
remediation: Never interpolate raw strings into <script> blocks. Use JSON.parse(element.dataset.props) or secure serialization.
